name: Alfalfa_Leaf_Mosaic_Virus
symptoms: leaves: Bright yellow mosaic patterns Chlorotic mottling Leaf distortion Narrow or elongated leaves Reduced leaf size plants: Stunted growth Reduced vigor Reduced yield
management: cultural_control: Use virus-free certified seeds Remove infected plants Control weeds that act as virus reservoirs vector_control: Monitor and manage aphid populations resistant_varieties: Some tolerant cultivars available depending on crop
